EXECUTION-ONLY correction for Mission Control PR #58 plus Hostinger relay pacing. Do not redesign or make reasoning decisions.

Accepted transport correction:
1. Add a global minimum ChatGPT submission interval for every actual browser message send: capability prompt, Extra High reader, Pro reasoner, Extra High liveness checker/writer, direct Extra High, and any automatic `continue` recovery. Default = 60,000 ms. Config env `MC_RELAY_MIN_SUBMISSION_INTERVAL_MS`, accepted range 15,000–600,000 ms.
2. The cooldown is measured from the timestamp of the last actual successful browser click/submission attempt that reached CLICKED/generation-start boundary, globally across all chats/routes, not per route. Persist it in relay state so restart cannot immediately burst another request.
3. Before any send, if cooldown remains, do not sleep/block for the whole interval inside the state machine. Return/write a fail-safe status such as `GLOBAL_SUBMISSION_COOLDOWN` with `retryAfterMs`/`nextSubmissionAt`; the normal loop can retry later. No click should occur during cooldown.
4. Ensure only one send path can cross the gate at a time. Reuse existing process/relay lock if it already guarantees this; otherwise add a narrow global submission mutex/serialized gate. Do not introduce a new scheduler.
5. Stuck-recovery `continue` must use the same global cooldown. Do not let recovery bypass pacing.
6. Add deterministic tests proving: two routes cannot send within the minimum interval; same-chat mode stages are paced; capability tests are paced; `continue` is paced; persisted last-submission time survives restart; no-send statuses do not mutate semantic authority.
7. Add the variable to `.env.example`, public config/status output, and README. Do not modify Mission Control authority semantics.

Immediate Hostinger mitigation, whether or not code patch is complete yet:
- set `MC_RELAY_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=90000` in the relay env;
- keep `MC_RELAY_SUBMIT_ENABLED=0` during the capability smoke;
- keep `MC_RELAY_CAPABILITY_TEST_ENABLED` only as needed for the harmless challenge;
- do not enable continuous real-task sending.

Use the exact existing task branch `task/mission-control-vps-browser-relay-20260902`. Start from current branch head. Commit only the pacing change and tests/docs. Run relay test/check suite and the existing repository/mission-control CI checkpoint if mechanically required by the repo. Push branch. Then update the Hostinger relay package to the new exact commit and run doctor + harmless capability smoke for chat `mc-hotfix-specialist` / URL `https://chatgpt.com/c/6a9847f8-3a44-83ea-9b41-181a240b2c26` using the already-provisioned hotfix-only COLLECTOR credential and endpoint `https://mission-control-hotfix-production.up.railway.app`.

Do not merge PR #58, do not touch Railway production, do not send real project supervision prompts, and do not read/parse assistant output. Return exact commit, tests, doctor/capability status, pacing status, and memory metrics. If interactive ChatGPT login is required, stop with `INTERACTIVE_CHATGPT_LOGIN_REQUIRED`.
